measurement.coldStateDefinition: Each sample starts a new CLI process and writes to a fresh output directory; required unmeasured warmups precede samples, so filesystem pages may be resident.
measurement.crossVersionReportComparison: Canonical JSON excluding only engineVersion; raw report SHA-256 and engineVersion remain recorded.
measurement.design: paired-interleaved for comparable R1/R2 commands; sequential fresh-process samples for R2-only commands

observabilityGaps: Repository analysis is included in end-to-end wall time and process RSS but has no dedicated AnalysisProfile phase.
The CLI has no embedding-provider, candidate-index operation, or index-path telemetry, so zero operations and zero index files outside the controlled corpus and output roots remain unproven.
Index size and candidate count are not applicable to measured similarity-disabled scenarios and unavailable for blocked index scenarios.
